Article 261bis of the Swiss Criminal Code (Strafgesetzbuch, StGB), which criminalizes incitement to hatred or discrimination against a person or a group of people based on several grounds, including race, ethnic origin, and religion, was amended to include **sexual orientation** in **2002**.

This amendment was part of broader efforts to strengthen protections against discrimination and hate crimes. The inclusion of sexual orientation in Article 261bis reflects Switzerland's commitment to combating homophobia and ensuring equal protection under the law for LGBTQ+ individuals.
